_readme: One entry per /advertise/ price card. When a Stripe Payment Link exists, paste it into `url` (and set its success URL to https://skillmaxx.gilventures.ai/sponsor/thanks/?slot=<key>). Empty url = the Book now button scrolls to the inquiry form with this slot preselected.
